theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcdp_smooth_homotopy
theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' m : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid N → Euclid N') (α : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') m), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Φ → IsSmoothForm α → IsSmoothForm (fun x => (α (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x))) ∧ ∀ (P k : ℕ) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → IsSmoothForm ω → IsSmoothForm (fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((ω (F x + t • (G x - F x))).curryLeft (G x - F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x + t • (fderiv ℝ G x - fderiv ℝ F x))) ∧ ∀ x, (ω (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x) - (ω (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x) = exteriorDerivative (fun x' => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((ω (F x' + t • (G x' - F x'))).curryLeft (G x' - F x')).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x' + t • (fderiv ℝ G x' - fderiv ℝ F x'))) x + ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((exteriorDerivative ω (F x + t • (G x - F x))).curryLeft (G x - F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x + t • (fderiv ℝ G x - fderiv ℝ F x))
